acceptance_criteria.description: Session creation uses an opaque random token, persists only its SHA-256 hash, and resolves only unexpired sessions.
Session expiry, logout, account-wide revocation, and fresh-token rotation primitives are available.
Session and pre-session cookies serialize with D-14 hosted attributes and pre-session lifetime/clearing behavior.
D-14 CSRF tokens use the specified HMAC wire format, expiry, constant-time verification, binding, pre-session issuance/rotation, and malformed-token rejection.
The CSRF service enforces an exact Origin match and leaves route handlers, login/register wiring, guards, throttling, and bootstrap for later increments.
